card.headline: EIE Department to Host NOMIZO'26 National Symposium
card.one_liner: SRMIST's EIE Department, in association with the Biomedical Society of India (BMESI), will host NOMIZO’26, a two-day national symposium on August 20-21, 2026. The event will feature engaging technical challenges, including 'Electro Escape' on Day 1.
